title: Veteran Trader Peter Brandt Drops Bombshell XRP Price Chart
body: Veteran commodity and crypto trader Peter Brandt has posted another trending XRP chart. This time, he added a coffee mug to the technical setup and marked $1.6572 as a key level above the current price. The unusual image references the classic cup-and-handle pattern, although Brandt did not explicitly identify the formation in his post. The chart adds another technical observation to a series of XRP posts Brandt has published over the past two weeks. Brandt Marks $1.6572 on XRP Chart Brandt’s recent chart tracks XRP against the U.S. dollar on the daily timeframe. The chart shows XRP trading near $1.5230 when Brandt published the image, while recent price action continues to consolidate around $1.50. Brandt marks $1.6572 with a horizontal line above the current price. XRP previously approached that region during its September advance before pulling back and entering a period of sideways trading. The coffee mug sits over the middle section of the chart. Brandt didn’t explain the image, but the placement could reference a cup-and-handle pattern. Technical analysts use that pattern to describe a rounded consolidation, followed by a smaller pullback that can precede a move higher. The XRP chart shows a prolonged rounded structure before the September advance, followed by consolidation near $1.50. That structure could explain why Brandt chose a coffee mug for the latest post. However, Brandt has not confirmed that he intended the image as a cup-and-handle reference. pic.twitter.com/UzAK96XjDR — The Factor Report (@PeterLBrandt) October 5, 2026 Brandt Continues His XRP Chart Posts Brandt has now published his third XRP chart in roughly two weeks. On September 22, Brandt shared a monthly XRP/USD chart that pointed to an eventual $5.40 advance. He also warned readers that a chart does not represent a trade and that an X post does not constitute proof. Five days later, Brandt shared another XRP chart that showed a possible inverse head-and-shoulders formation. XRP traded around $1.52 at the time, and Brandt said charts alone had always given him enough reason to make a bet. His latest post continues that recent focus on XRP’s technical structure. Rather than provide a lengthy written analysis, Brandt uses the chart itself to show the price action and the $1.6572 level he has marked. Brandt’s Earlier XRP Position Brandt’s recent technical analysis contrasts with his earlier criticism of XRP. He called XRP a scam in 2020 but retracted it in 2021. He later criticized XRP investors for what he considered excessive bias and questioned aspects of XRP’s fundamentals. We are on X, follow us to connect with us :- @TimesTabloid1 — TimesTabloid (@TimesTabloid1) June 15, 2025 His recent posts have focused more directly on price charts and technical formations. His September chart carried a $5.40 long-term target, while his second chart presented a possible inverse head-and-shoulders setup. The recent chart shows another possible technical reference through the coffee mug. If Brandt intended the image to represent a cup-and-handle formation, the $1.6572 level could become an important area for traders watching the setup. Brandt, however, has not explicitly confirmed that interpretation. For now, XRP remains near $1.52 and below the $1.6572 level on Brandt’s chart. The next move toward or away from that level will determine whether the technical structure develops further. title: Strategy (MSTR) stock rises as Bitcoin holdings hit record 848,000
body: Strategy (MSTR) stock, formerly known as MicroStrategy, gained 2% on Monday after the Bitcoin treasury company disclosed another purchase of the cryptocurrency, taking its total holdings to a record 848,000 BTC. The company acquired 334 BTC for approximately $28.7 million between September 28 and October 4, according to a filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission. The latest purchases were made at an average price of $85,838.80 per Bitcoin. Strategy’s total Bitcoin holdings are now worth around $73 billion. Its average purchase price stands at $75,440.70 per Bitcoin, with the total cost of its holdings reaching around $64 billion, including fees and expenses. Strategy expands Bitcoin holdings The latest acquisition brings Strategy’s Bitcoin holdings to more than 4% of the cryptocurrency’s 21 million supply cap. Based on current prices, the holdings imply around $9 billion in paper gains. The company financed the latest purchases through proceeds from sales of its Class A common stock and its USD Cash reserve. Strategy sold 92,894 MSTR shares for approximately $15.7 million during the previous week. As of October 4, the company had $18.8 billion worth of MSTR shares available for issuance and sale under its at-the-market programme. The remaining $13 million of the Bitcoin acquisition was funded using Strategy’s USD Cash holdings. Strategy also repurchased 1.77 million STRC preferred shares last week for around $176.3 million. The company used $154.1 million from its USD Cash reserve for the latest Bitcoin purchases, while $22.2 million came from interest earned on its cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments. Cash reserves support purchases Strategy reported that its USD Reserve stood at $4.88 billion as of October 4, while USD Cash holdings were $833.4 million. The company also used $142.5 million from its USD Reserve to fund preferred-stock dividends and interest on its outstanding debt. Strategy executive chairman and co-founder Michael Saylor disclosed the company’s total Bitcoin holdings and average acquisition price. Saylor also posted a Bitcoin acquisition tracker chart on X on Sunday with the caption “More orange than ever.” Similar posts have previously preceded Bitcoin acquisition announcements, although the company’s strategy has varied in recent periods. Strategy remains the largest public-company Bitcoin holder. Bitcoin Treasuries data showed that 196 public companies have adopted some form of Bitcoin acquisition model. Strategy estimates $20.9B gain Strategy also provided an early estimate of its digital-asset performance for the third quarter. The company expects to report a $20.91 billion gain on digital assets for the quarter. The carrying value of its Bitcoin holdings stood at $70.82 billion as of September 30. Despite the latest Bitcoin purchases, both Strategy stock and Bitcoin remain below their levels from a year ago. MSTR has gained 3% year to date but has fallen more than 50% over the past 12 months. title: Veteran analyst Peter Brandt sets the key XRP breakout level
body: Market analyst Peter Brandt’s latest XRP chart coverage points to a developing “cup-and-handle” pattern , with the September 23 high of $1.65 emerging as the key level XRP needs to break for the setup to gain confirmation. The pattern is a bullish chart formation that resembles a cup with a handle, consisting of a rounded bottom followed by a slight downward pullback, which actually indicates a potential upward breakout. Brandt’s data , published on October 5, shows XRP trading around $1.52, slightly above the displayed 200-day simple moving average ( MA ) at $1.49. For the pattern to receive stronger confirmation, the pattern suggests, XRP would need to break above the $1.65 cup rim, which would require a gain of approximately 9%. pic.twitter.com/UzAK96XjDR — The Factor Report (@PeterLBrandt) October 5, 2026 Peter Brandt is still bullish on XRP The larger part of the pattern began with XRP’s August rally toward the mid-$1.6 range, and the cryptocurrency subsequently reversed lower, falling into the $1.25-1.3 area by mid-September. It then recovered sharply, eventually reaching $1.65 on September 23 and returning to the area where the earlier decline began. Since reaching the September 23 high, XRP has pulled back without revisiting the cup’s low, consolidating between roughly $1.45 and $1.55 and forming the smaller structure that could become the “handle.” A break below the handle’s recent support around $1.45 would weaken the bullish setup, though the chart’s average directional index (ADX) reading of 43.8 also points to a strong existing trend. The latest chart adds to a series of XRP-focused updates from Brandt in recent weeks. In late September, his long-term XRP charts implied a potential price of $5.4 , although he did not provide a timeframe for that level. “This is my long-term chart of XRP. It implies an eventual advance to $5.40,” he wrote. This is my long-term chart of ripple:native It implies an eventual advance to $5.40 A claim of a "call" or simple presentation of a chart is NOT a trade People who claim "trades" need to provide proof or else the claims are BS An X post is NOT proof pic.twitter.com/Szu6FiZq2T — The Factor Report (@PeterLBrandt) September 21, 2026 For now, though, the technical picture comes down to one level: XRP needs to clear $1.65 for the developing cup-and-handle pattern to gain stronger confirmation. title: Buying Wind in the Cryptocurrency Market! Significant Activity in Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana! Here are the Details…
body: While Bitcoin, Ethereum, and altcoins have shown sideways movement in recent days, treasury companies continue their purchases. Firstly, Strategy, the world’s largest publicly traded Bitcoin holder, also made purchases this week. According to a statement by Strategy founder Michael Saylor, Strategy purchased an additional 334 Bitcoin. This brings the company’s total Bitcoin holdings to 848,000 BTC. The company also repurchased STRC preferred shares worth $176 million. Saylor noted that Strategy also holds $5.7 billion in assets, adding that the company’s dollar-denominated assets could cover current preferred stock dividends and interest payments for approximately 3.6 years. Besides Strategy, Strive also made a BTC purchase. Accordingly, Strive announced that it bought an additional 2,000 Bitcoin worth $169 million. With this purchase, Strive’s total Bitcoin holdings reportedly increased to 29,462 BTC. The average purchase price was stated to be $84,422 per Bitcoin. Strive CEO Matt Cole announced that 61.5% of the acquisition funds came from SATA, while $56.7 million was raised through stock options. Ethereum Purchases Continue! Bitmine, the world’s largest holder of Ethereum, also announced last week that it purchased an additional 15,112 ETH, bringing its total holdings to 6,016,414 ETH. According to the announcement, this represents 4.9% of the total circulating ETH supply. The official statement also noted that Bitmine’s total assets, including cryptocurrency, cash, marketable securities, and strategic investment assets, have reached $17.4 billion. This figure includes 6 million ETH, 214 Bitcoin, $643 million in cash and marketable securities, $180 million worth of Beast Industries shares, and $117 million worth of Eightco Holdings shares. Bitmine Chairman Tom Lee stated, “We believe cryptocurrencies have entered what we perceive as a bull market cycle. Last week, we acquired 15,112 ETH. Bitmine’s consistent success in purchasing cryptocurrencies is unparalleled by any publicly traded company in the world. Bitmine has purchased ETH every week since the launch of its ETH Treasury Strategy on June 30, 2025.” Solana Procurement Announced Too! Last week, Nasdaq-listed company DeFi Development Corp. announced it had purchased an additional 26,203 Solana, bringing its total SOL holdings to 2.564 million. The company also stated that it generated additional SOL and commission revenue by using its SOL holdings for staking and operating its own validator. *This is not investment advice.
